comment: Licensing (Art 51, now a business licence under UU 6/2023; Art 89A), Rp1.5bn deposit (Art 54(1)(b)), duty to resolve problems of placed workers (Art 52(1)(c)), revocation without ending responsibility (Art 58). No joint ('tanggung renteng') liability in UU 18/2017 or PP 59/2021. Source fix: sanctions are Arts 74 and 58, not 72-73.

Art 30(1) UU 18/2017 confirmed. BP2MI Reg 9/2020 and its 2021 amendment were REVOKED by Permen P2MI/BP2MI 17/2025 (Art 9; in force 2025-08-26). New rule: employer bears placement costs for all occupations by default (Art 2(6)), but exceptions shift costs to workers (Art 3(1)-(2)); Minister may set caps (Art 6). Fits 1 (arguably 2). Rewrite note and source. 2021 postponement and Kepka 214/2021 not verified.

UU 18/2017 Art 13(g)-(h) placement agreement and employment contract; Art 15(2) minimum contents; Art 15(3) delegates verification, now Permen P2MI/BP2MI 3/2026 Art 12(1) (contract authenticated by the authorised official, Art 1(13)), replacing Perban 1/2020. Exception: company-placed workers for own business (Art 13(2)). Cite the 2026 regulation for verification.

OPP defined in PP 59/2021 Art 1(11), compulsory via P3MI duty Art 86(3)(k); provinces facilitate (Art 59(c)). UU 18/2017 Art 30 has no list of costs and never mentions OPP; Permen 17/2025 Art 2 does not list OPP. No legal text found that OPP is free, so 2 vs 1 needs checking. Fix note and source.

Art 29(1) and Art 5(d) UU 18/2017; Permenaker 4/2023 Art 4(1) makes JKK and JKM compulsory, covers disability and repatriation. Legal aid from the State (Art 21(1)(f)). KP2MI's Permen P2MI/BP2MI 9/2026 on Social Security (2026-08-28) now governs the same matter; consider citing it.
Art 22(1): central government establishes labour attaché posts in certain countries; Elucidation defines them as destination countries chosen by placement numbers. Art 21(1)(a), Art 39(n).

Art 77: deliberation, then labour agencies (77(2)), then courts (77(3)). Sanctions Arts 74 and 58; Permen 17/2025 Art 8. UU 21/2007 Art 48 restitution in criminal judgment. No specialised compensation body. Source fix: Arts 78-79 are investigation powers.

Minimum age 18 (UU 18/2017 Art 5(a)). Kepmenaker 260/2015 in force per JDIH Kemnaker and BP2MI (19 countries, sex-neutral on its face): drop 'status to be confirmed'. The pilot one-channel system Kepmenaker 291/2018 (and 202/2023) was REVOKED by Kepmenaker 8/2026 (2026-01-20); update note and source. Drop news sources.

Art 41 (districts must carry out social and economic reintegration); Art 24(1)(d)-(e); Art 42(e); Art 45(g); Art 47(e)-(f). KP2MI's role comes from the 2024 restructuring (Perpres 165/2024 and 166/2024), not the 2017 Law.
RA 8042 s.10 as amended by RA 10022 s.7: joint and several liability; corporate officers personally liable. Licensing by DMW (RA 11641 s.3(h)).

2023 DMW Landbased Rules (DC 01 s. 2023, 9 Jun 2023) s.56: fee capped at one month's basic salary; not allowed for domestic workers or where destination bars fees; s.59 bars other fees; s.58 employer pays visa, airfare, DMW, OWWA fees. HSW no-fee: POEA GBR 6 s. 2006 (effective 15 Dec 2006 via GBR 11). Seafarers: 2026 DMW Seabased Rules (DC 06 s. 2026, effective 2 Jul 2026) s.54. No-fee destinations by advisory (e.g. Advisory 24 s. 2024, Qatar). OCR of scanned PDFs: check wording. Statute itself sets no amount.

RA 11641 s.15(b) MWO verifies contracts; RA 8042 s.10 makes joint-liability clause a condition for approval; s.6(i) 'approved and verified'. Standard-contract requirement per hire type sits in DMW rules (not checked).

Compulsory verified: Landbased Rules s.169 (PEOS mandatory); Citizen's Charter 2025 lists PEOS and PDOS certificates; MC 02 s. 2024 (Kuwait); Seabased Rules s.202 makes PEOS and PDOS mandatory; Advisory 34 s. 2024 (OWWA issues PDOS). Free: only partly; PEOS fee 'None', but PDOS also by accredited in-house, NGO and agency providers. owwa.gov.ph blocked (Cloudflare). Statutes cited (RA 10022, RA 10801) don't support 2 on their own.

RA 10801 s.4 Fund, s.8 compulsory membership, s.35(e) death/disability, s.35(b) repatriation, s.6(b) legal assistance. RA 8042 s.37-A (RA 10022 s.23) compulsory insurance for agency hires at no cost to the worker.

RA 11641 s.15: MWOs at all posts within three years 'as far as practicable', priority for high-OFW countries; absorbs POLO and OSWA (RA 11299). Source fix: RA 8042 s.19 is the Migrant Workers Resource Center (now RA 11641 s.16).
RA 8042 s.10 as amended: NLRC labor arbiters have original and exclusive jurisdiction; joint and several liability. RA 11641 s.8(j), s.9(c) DMW adjudicates recruitment violations.

HSW minimum age is 23, not 25: GBR 4 s. 2006 set 25 regardless of gender; GBR 2 s. 2007 lowered to 23 for all genders; GBR 4 s. 2011 allows exemptions. Landbased Rules s.122, s.120 (bans after DFA consultation). Statute: RA 8042 s.4 certified destinations, s.5 bans; RA 11641 s.8(k). Kuwait: GB bans 2018 and 2020 (titles only); 2023 not a full ban (Advisories 05 and 06 s. 2023 deferred first-time agency-hire domestic workers; Advisory 14 s. 2023); MC 01 s. 2024 resumed skilled workers; MC 02 s. 2024 resumed domestic workers with prior overseas experience only. Afghanistan (GBR 7 s. 2021), Ukraine (GBR 1 s. 2022) bans titles only; Saudi ban lifted (DO 04 s. 2022).
Value and substance correct; source wrong. NRCO is RA 8042 s.17 as amended by RA 10022 s.10, services s.18 (RA 10022 s.11). RA 11641 s.19(e) merges NRCO into DMW; s.17 makes it lead office.

Art 7(5), Art 10 licence; charter capital VND 5 billion (not 'legal capital'); deposit Arts 10(1)(b), 24. Art 26(2)(h) compensates only damage it caused; 'liên đới' never appears. Law 22/2026 (effective 01/03/2027) repeals Arts 11-15 and moves licence procedures to a decree.

Art 23(4)(a) caps confirmed (one month per 12 months, three months max). Art 23(2)(c): fee only after supply contract approved and placement contract signed. Art 7(8) bans brokerage from workers. Wrong: 'zero cap for Japan under 2024 amendment'. Circular 02/2024 repealed by Circular 09/2026 Art 4(3) from 30/06/2026. Under 09/2026: zero brokerage commission for Japan (Annex X); worker service fee zero in Japan only for TITP No. 3 and SSW after TITP No. 2/3, 0.7 months per 12 for engineers (Annex XI); general brokerage cap 0.5 months per 12 (Art 7).

Art 19(2) minimum content of supply contract; Art 20(1) prior Ministry approval; Art 21 written placement contract in model form. Source fix: Art 44 is worker eligibility; worker contract is Art 21. Law 22/2026 amends Arts 18, 21 from 03/2027.

Compulsory with certificate confirmed (Art 6(2)(c), 44(5), 65(2)); content includes rights and hotlines (65(1)(k),(m)); 74 periods (Circular 21 Art 12, Annex XII as amended). No provision on who pays; model contract does not list orientation among worker costs; Japan TITP annex makes foreign party pay. Note's 'cost may be collected from the worker' unsupported.

Decision 40/2021 replaced by Decision 34/2025/QĐ-TTg from 15/09/2025. Law Arts 66-68 correct (Art 67(1) support for early return, insolvency, abuse, disputes, death). Decision 34/2025: VND 100,000 per worker per contract (Art 8); 50% of lawyer and court costs up to VND 50m (Art 13); VND 40m on death (Art 14); 50% of repatriation of remains (Art 19). Social insurance Art 6(1)(c), 6(2)(h).

Art 72 is dispute settlement. Basis is Art 70(2)(c) (Ministry posts civil servants to missions, with Foreign Affairs) and Art 71 (missions' duties). Law doesn't say 'labor management sections' or name countries. Value 2 defensible.

Decree 12/2022 replaced by Decree 283/2026 from 10/09/2026 (Art 66(4)). Law Art 6(1)(h), 69(7), 25(4), 72(1). Decree 283/2026 Art 49 lets the authority order refunds with interest (points đ, e, g) and point d compensation for damage caused, which partly undercuts 'compensation needs the courts'; a remedial order, not an adjudicating body, so 1 probably stands. Coder to review.
Minimum age 18 (Art 3(1)). Prohibited jobs Art 7(12) and areas Art 7(13), sex-neutral. Source fix: Art 7 clauses 12-13, not an 'Appendix'. Law 22/2026 amends Art 7(1), (9), (11) from 01/03/2027.

Art 61 only encourages voluntary psychosocial counselling. Employment duties are Art 60: Ministry guides provinces; provinces 'based on budget capacity' may adopt support; employment service centres provide labour-market information; enterprises help with job referral. 'Self-employment loans' not in the Law. Coder to consider 1.
